description: Corpus of 22 American and Mexican languages, dialects, and indigenous varieties for support training and evaluation.

examples.query: Mi iPhone se calienta un chingo y la pila no dura nada, se baja de volada.
examples.english_translation: My iPhone gets extremely hot and the battery doesn't last at all, it drains super fast.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: iPhone overheating battery drains rapidly fast
examples.sample_reply: Estamos para ayudarte con la batería de tu iPhone. Por favor mándanos un DM indicando tu versión de iOS y condición de batería.

examples.query: Oigan @AppleSupport no jala la pantalla de mi cel, se trabó y se quedó negro.
examples.english_translation: Hey @AppleSupport, my phone screen is not working, it froze and stayed black.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: iPhone display screen not working frozen black
examples.sample_reply: Queremos ayudarte con la pantalla. Intenta forzar el reinicio presionando Subir Volumen, Bajar Volumen y mantener presionado el botón lateral.

examples.query: Me cobraron doble lana en mi tarjeta por una suscripción que cancelé, exijo mi reembolso.
examples.english_translation: They double charged money on my card for a subscription I cancelled, I demand my refund.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Double charge on credit card unauthorized billing refund
examples.sample_reply: Te ayudamos con la facturación. Para revisar cobros de forma segura sin compartir datos privados, envíanos un DM o visita reportaproblem.apple.com.

examples.query: Hackearon mi cuenta de Apple ID y cambiaron mi correo y contraseña.
examples.english_translation: They hacked my Apple ID account and changed my email and password.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Apple ID hacked compromised account password changed
examples.sample_reply: La seguridad de tu Apple ID es prioritaria. Por favor visita https://iforgot.apple.com inmediatamente o contáctanos por DM.

examples.query: Mi phone se freezeó después de hacer update a iOS 11 y la battery está dying bien rápido.
examples.english_translation: My phone froze after updating to iOS 11 and the battery is dying really fast.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: iPhone frozen after iOS update battery draining dying fast
examples.sample_reply: Estamos listos para ayudarte. Mándanos un DM con el modelo de tu iPhone para revisar el rendimiento de tu batería.

examples.query: No puedo loguear a mi Apple ID porque me pide el two-factor code en un number que ya no tengo.
examples.english_translation: I can't log in to my Apple ID because it asks for the two-factor code on a number I no longer have.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Cannot login to Apple ID two factor authentication code phone number lost
examples.sample_reply: Te ayudamos a recuperar tu acceso de forma segura. Inicia la recuperación en https://iforgot.apple.com o mándanos un DM.

examples.query: Notepoz amo tequiti, chicahualiztli cenca totonqui ihuan tlapantoc.
examples.english_translation: My electronic device does not work, the power/battery is very hot and the screen is cracked.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Device not working battery overheating hot display broken
examples.sample_reply: Ti mitzpalehuizqueh. Tla xitechmocuilili ce DM ica motepoz modelo. / Estamos para ayudarte. Envíanos un DM con tu modelo.

examples.query: Nechtominqui tomin amo nictemouh ipan notepoz Apple.
examples.english_translation: Money was taken/charged that I did not ask for on my Apple device.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Money charged unauthorized billing transaction
examples.sample_reply: Timitzpalehuizqueh ica tomin. Por favor visita reportaproblem.apple.com o envíanos un DM para proteger tu cuenta.

examples.query: Le u nu'ukulil ma' táan u meyaj, jach choko' le u k'iini' yéetel pa'ax u yich.
examples.english_translation: The device is not working, the battery is very hot and its screen is broken.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Device not working battery very hot screen broken
examples.sample_reply: K-k'áat áantkech. Túuxt to'on junp'éel DM yéetel u modeloil a nu'ukul. / Queremos ayudarte, envíanos un DM.

examples.query: Tu ch'a'aj taak'in ma' in k'áati' ti' Apple Store.
examples.english_translation: They took money I didn't want in the Apple Store.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Unauthorized charge money deducted Apple Store billing
examples.sample_reply: Te ayudamos a resolver este cobro. Por favor visita reportaproblem.apple.com o contáctanos por DM.

examples.query: Guendanabani sti' celular cadi cayaca chaahui, rilaa naxhi.
examples.english_translation: The phone's battery life is not working well, it drains quickly.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone battery life not working well draining quickly
examples.sample_reply: Racanenu lii. Biseenda ti DM ra nuudu. / Te ayudamos con gusto. Envíanos un DM con tu modelo de iPhone.

examples.query: Guti bidxichi lu tarjeta stine sin gabe.
examples.english_translation: Money was deducted from my card without me knowing.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Money deducted credit card without authorization
examples.sample_reply: Revisamos tu facturación de inmediato. Para proteger tus datos, contáctanos por DM o entra a reportaproblem.apple.com.

examples.query: Kóo kánuu teléfono yu'u, xíña nǐ'no batería ta nándi'i.
examples.english_translation: My phone is not working, the battery is very hot and finished.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone not working battery very hot discharged
examples.sample_reply: Kúni ndu chintée ndu ro'ó. Chi'i iin DM. / Queremos ayudarte, envíanos un DM para asistirte.

otomi.name: Otomi (Hñähñu)
otomi.region: Central Mexico (Hidalgo, Querétaro, Estado de México)

examples.query: Ma teléfono hin gi pe̱fi xá ntsaya, pa ntsaya batería.
examples.english_translation: My phone does not work well, the battery gets very hot.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone does not work well battery very hot overheating
examples.sample_reply: Di ne gä fats'i'i. Penz'ähe n'na DM. / Queremos apoyarte con tu equipo. Escríbenos un DM.

examples.query: Tuxá la teléfono, lakgastapu tsinki chu batería lhuwa chichi.
examples.english_translation: The phone is not working, the screen is frozen and the battery is very hot.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone not working screen frozen display battery hot
examples.sample_reply: Kinaankán katsiyáaw nalaktáxtuya. Pukskíwan akgtum DM. / Estamos aquí para apoyarte. Mándanos un DM.

examples.query: Tási gayena maquina, rata batería simi.
examples.english_translation: The machine/phone cannot function, the battery is running hot.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Device cannot function battery hot overheating
examples.sample_reply: Kuira ba! Te ayudamos con tu teléfono. Envíanos un DM para darte asistencia técnica.

huasteco.name: Huasteco (Teenek)
huasteco.region: La Huasteca (San Luis Potosí, Veracruz, Tamaulipas)

examples.query: Yab in t'ojnal an celular, k'ak'al an batería.
examples.english_translation: The cell phone is not working, the battery is hot.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Cell phone not working battery hot overheating
examples.sample_reply: I tólmiyal k'al a celular. Ts'iha' jun i DM. / Te auxiliamos con tu celular. Envíanos un DM.

examples.query: My iPhone is bricked in a bootloop after the iOS 11 update and battery is tanking.
examples.english_translation: My iPhone is bricked in a bootloop after the iOS 11 update and battery is tanking.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: iPhone bricked bootloop after iOS update battery draining
examples.sample_reply: We're here to help. Try connecting your iPhone to a computer and entering Recovery Mode to update without losing data.

examples.query: My battery is swollen and literally smoking on my desk!
examples.english_translation: My battery is swollen and literally smoking on my desk!
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Battery swollen smoking physical safety hazard
examples.sample_reply: Please safely disconnect the device immediately, do not attempt to charge it, and DM us so our safety team can assist.

examples.query: Mon cellulaire est pogné sur la pomme pis la batterie se vide d'une shot.
examples.english_translation: My phone is stuck on the Apple logo and the battery empties in one shot.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Cell phone stuck Apple logo battery draining instantly
examples.sample_reply: Nous sommes là pour vous aider avec votre cellulaire. Envoyez-nous un message direct avec votre modèle d'iPhone.

examples.query: J'ai été facturé deux fois sur ma carte de crédit pour un abonnement App Store.
examples.english_translation: I was charged twice on my credit card for an App Store subscription.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Double charge credit card App Store subscription refund
examples.sample_reply: Nous sommes là pour vous aider. Pour vérifier cette transaction en toute sécurité, visitez reportaproblem.apple.com ou écrivez-nous en DM.

ht_creole.name: Haitian Creole (Kreyòl Ayisyen)
ht_creole.region: Caribbean / Haiti & US Diaspora (Florida, NY, Boston)

examples.query: Telefòn mwen an pa vle mache, batri a ap desann twò vit apre mizajou a.
examples.english_translation: My phone won't work, the battery is going down too fast after the update.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone not working battery draining too fast after update
examples.sample_reply: Nou la pou ede w ak batri iPhone ou a. Tanpri voye yon DM ba nou ak modèl telefòn ou an.

examples.query: Yo chaje kat mwen an de fwa pou menm aplikasyon an nan Apple Store.
examples.english_translation: They charged my card twice for the same app in the Apple Store.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Card charged twice duplicate App Store purchase billing dispute
examples.sample_reply: Nou la pou ede w rezoud pwoblèm sa a san danje. Tanpri vizite reportaproblem.apple.com oswa voye yon DM pou nou.

examples.query: Béésh bee haneʼé doo naalnish da, atsʼíís deesdoi chena.
examples.english_translation: The telephone does not work, its body is very hot.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone not working body very hot overheating battery
examples.sample_reply: Yá'át'ééh! We're here to help with your device. Please send us a DM with your iPhone model so we can assist.

examples.query: Béeso shaa néitʼą́ą́ʼ doo shił bééhózin da.
examples.english_translation: Money was taken from me without my knowledge.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Money taken unauthorized charge transaction billing
examples.sample_reply: We will help you resolve this billing issue securely. Please visit reportaproblem.apple.com or DM us directly.

examples.query: ᏗᏟᏃᎮᏗ Ꮭ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁ, ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏗᎴᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
examples.english_translation: The phone is not working, its body is becoming hot.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone not working body overheating battery hot
examples.sample_reply: ᎣᏏᏲ! We are here to help. Send us a DM with your phone model and iOS version so we can assist.

examples.query: ᎠᏕᎳ ᏓᏇᎩᏍᏓᏁ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ Apple Store.
examples.english_translation: Money was taken from me without my knowing at Apple Store.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Money taken unauthorized purchase App Store billing dispute
examples.sample_reply: We will help investigate this charge. Please verify transactions at reportaproblem.apple.com or message us via DM.

examples.query: Uqaalautiga aullaqattangittuq, kiatsartualuk battery nungulertuq.
examples.english_translation: My phone is not working, it is overheating and battery is finishing.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone not working overheating battery finishing draining
examples.sample_reply: Ainngai! We're here to help troubleshoot your phone's battery. Please send us a DM with your device details.

examples.query: Kiinaujaq akiliqtaujara suurlu unatausimangittuq.
examples.english_translation: Money was charged that was not requested.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Money charged unauthorized transaction billing
examples.sample_reply: We're here to help review this charge safely. Please DM us or check reportaproblem.apple.com.

examples.query: Meu iPhone tá travando direto depois da atualização e a bateria tá viciada, descarrega voando.
examples.english_translation: My iPhone keeps freezing after the update and the battery is ruined, drains flying.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: iPhone freezing after update battery degraded draining fast
examples.sample_reply: Estamos aqui para ajudar! Por favor nos envie uma DM informando o modelo do seu iPhone e a versão do iOS para verificarmos a bateria.

examples.query: Cobrança indevida no meu cartão de crédito pela App Store de R$ 150,00 que eu não reconheço.
examples.english_translation: Unauthorized charge on my credit card from App Store of R$ 150.00 that I don't recognize.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Unauthorized credit card charge App Store transaction dispute refund
examples.sample_reply: Queremos te ajudar com essa cobrança com segurança. Acesse reportaproblem.apple.com ou nos chame por DM.

examples.query: Hackearam minha conta do iCloud e trocaram minha senha e número de confiança.
examples.english_translation: They hacked my iCloud account and changed my password and trusted number.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: iCloud account hacked password changed trusted number modified
examples.sample_reply: A segurança da sua conta é prioridade máxima. Acesse https://iforgot.apple.com imediatamente ou nos mande uma DM para suporte seguro.

examples.query: Celulary mana allintachu llamk'an, baterian q'uñipakun chaymanta wañukun.
examples.english_translation: My cell phone doesn't work well, the battery gets hot and dies.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone not working battery gets hot dies overheating
examples.sample_reply: Allillanchu! Yanapasaykiku celularykimanta. Chiqap DM nisqata apachimuwankiku. / Estamos para ayudarte, envíanos un DM.

examples.query: Qullqiyta urquspan tarjetaymanta mana mañakusqayta.
examples.english_translation: My money was taken from my card without me asking.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Money taken from credit card unauthorized billing dispute
examples.sample_reply: Te ayudamos a resolver este cobro. Por favor visita reportaproblem.apple.com o contáctanos por DM.

examples.query: Che celular ndomomba'apói porã, batería hakueterei ha pya'e opave.
examples.english_translation: My cell phone doesn't work well, the battery is very hot and finishes quickly.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Cell phone not working well battery very hot finishes rapidly
examples.sample_reply: Ropeipirũ ropytyvõ hag̃ua. Emondo oréve peteĩ DM. / Te ayudamos con tu celular. Envíanos un DM.

examples.query: Ojeipe'a chehegui pirapire che tarjeta gui Apple Store pe.
examples.english_translation: Money was taken from me from my card at Apple Store.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Money taken from credit card unauthorized Apple Store billing
examples.sample_reply: Te ayudamos con esta transacción. Ingresa a reportaproblem.apple.com o envíanos un DM para revisarlo de forma segura.

examples.query: Celularaxa janiw walikiti, batería junt'utapuniwa ukat jiwi.
examples.english_translation: My phone is not well, the battery is always hot and dies.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone not working properly battery always hot dies overheating
examples.sample_reply: Kamisaraki! Yanapapxämaw celularataki. Mā DM qillqt'apxita. / Te ayudamos con tu equipo. Envíanos un DM.

examples.query: Parce, mi iPhone se quedó pegado y la batería se descarga de una, qué vaina.
examples.english_translation: Mate, my iPhone got stuck and the battery discharges immediately, what a hassle.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: iPhone stuck frozen battery discharges immediately
examples.sample_reply: Hola! Estamos listos para ayudarte con tu iPhone. Escríbenos por DM indicándonos el modelo y la versión de iOS que tienes.

examples.query: Me están cobrando una plata en la tarjeta de crédito por una suscripción que no pedí.
examples.english_translation: They are charging me money on my credit card for a subscription I didn't ask for.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Money charged credit card subscription unauthorized billing dispute
examples.sample_reply: Te colaboramos con tu cobro de forma segura. Por favor escríbenos por DM o verifica el cobro en reportaproblem.apple.com.

examples.query: Che @AppleSupport, el celu se me tildó con iOS 11 y la batería no dura un carajo, se muere al 30%.
examples.english_translation: Hey @AppleSupport, the phone froze on me with iOS 11 and the battery doesn't last at all, it dies at 30%.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Phone froze with iOS update battery dies at 30 percent
examples.sample_reply: ¡Hola! Queremos ayudarte con tu iPhone. Mandanos un DM con el modelo y el porcentaje de salud de tu batería para ayudarte a resolverlo.

examples.query: Me debitaron dos veces la guita de la tarjeta por una app, necesito que me devuelvan la plata.
examples.english_translation: They debited the money twice from my card for an app, I need them to refund the money.
examples.normalized_diagnostic_query: Debited twice credit card unauthorized money charge refund
examples.sample_reply: Te ayudamos con la facturación. Para gestionar el reembolso de forma segura, visitá reportaproblem.apple.com o mandanos un DM.
